name: Leandre Thaïs
source:
AGE: 24
HEIGHT: 182cm
BORN: April 23
WEIGHT: 76kg
NATIONALITY: French & Arab
WEAKNESS: Willpower

[i]For every extraordinary person doing extraordinary things, there are countless ordinary individuals doing ordinary things, their lives unremarkable in every way.[/i]

A young man with a gentle spirit whose only claim to fame is via association with his older brother, Renard. Leandre Thaïs is just an average public university student living a quiet life, happily supporting his brother from the shadows and grateful to be supported in return. He carries his favorite book of poetry with him at all times and is greatly comforted by the words scrawled within.

Likes: Poetry, tea, libraries, relaxing, listening, supporting others, floral scents
Dislikes: Confrontation, people badmouthing his brother
